title: review-run shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the CLI, hook, meta, audit and log schemas. config.json embeds its own copies.

run_id.description: rr- plus 8 lowercase base32 characters (a-z2-7); never reused.

run_ref.description: Input form only: a unique prefix of at least 4 characters after rr-, the rr- optional. Not used in output.

pr.description: host/<full project path>#N (GitLab MR numbers without !).

draft_id.description: pr-comment's draft id (26 characters of Crockford base32), supplied by pr-comment draft new.

ts.description: UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix, optional fractional seconds.

actor.description: human:<name> or auto:<name>. A claim, advisory against same-user processes.

duration.description: 0, or an integer and a unit: ms, s, m, h, d.

label.description: key=value, split at the first '='; the label grammar of architecture section 8.1.

labels.description: Multiset of key=value pairs in stored order, verbatim.

file_id.description: A manifest file id, f plus four digits in forgectl's file order.

skill.description: A name Claude Code accepts as a slash command (plugin:skill or a bare name).

state.description: running: in a phase or its session is live. done and failed are terminal. escalated: the session reported needs-input or blocked and its agent is kept.

refusal_reason.description: Exit 20 reasons; found before any run record exists or on a run in the wrong state.

run_exit_code.description: The exit code a run ended with (a failed run: its failure; escalated: 13; done: 0).

verdict.description: The session's claim, stored as given; never used by review-run to act.

severity_counts.description: Counted by review-run from the findings.

reviewed.description: The session's file ids intersected with the provided entries.

skipped.description: Every provided, truncated or skipped manifest entry not reviewed; binary and empty entries are in neither list. A truncated entry is always skipped (truncated), even when the session lists it.

ignored_ids.description: How many ids the session listed that were not provided entries; they are ignored.

reason.description: Set exactly when status is skipped.

exit_code.description: null with a signal, when skipped and when not configured.

signal.description: The terminating signal name, else null.

sandbox.description: The mode the command ran in; null when it did not run.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sanitized output; null when it did not run.

code_run.description: The code-run step's summary. status failed means a non-zero exit, a signal or a timeout; timed_out and truncated are independent booleans. The output itself is stored in the run directory, not here.

pointer.description: Untrusted: the JSON pointer of the parent object the rule applied to; never a dropped key name.

normalized_entry.description: At most 200 entries are kept, then one entry with rule truncated and pointer empty (count: the entries omitted).

tool.description: The sibling tool that failed, else null.

retryable.description: Whether a retry can help; set per reason in the Reasons table.

retry_after_s.description: Seconds, when the sibling gave a retry-after.

pointer.description: Untrusted: a JSON pointer into the artifact, cut to 200 characters.

errors.description: Pointers and kinds only, never a message or a value.

failure.description: Why a run failed, in closed codes, ids and counts. Always set for a failed run; null otherwise.

event_id.description: Identifies one hook delivery; a hook is delivered at least once and deduplicated by event_id.

run_warning.description: Closed list of run-level warning codes.

anchor.description: From pr-comment draft new; the session copies it, never invents it.

path.description: Absolute path of the stored review.json.

original_sha256.description: SHA-256 of original.json, the byte-exact frozen copy.

artifact_ref.description: The stored review.json (immutable once the run is done). Its content is untrusted text.

code_run_reason.description: Set exactly when code_run_status is skipped.

normalized_count.description: The total count of normalization fixes applied.

run_summary.description: The meta.review_run fields of the same names (coverage.status and code_run.status flattened) plus counts. The verdict and risk are the session's claims.

path.description: Untrusted: a path from the PR.

old_path.description: Untrusted: the previous path of a renamed file, else null.

inputs.description: Input file names; empty for binary and empty entries.

disposition.description: skipped_size_cap and skipped_file_cap are the manifest's skipped(size_cap) and skipped(file_cap).

cmd.description: Run through sh -c in its own process group.

hook_entry_pre.description: Exit 0 continues; 13 escalates; any other non-zero exit or a timeout vetoes (exit 11).

cmd.description: Run through sh -c in its own process group.

async.description: Run detached under a watchdog that enforces the timeout.

hook_entry_post.description: Cannot undo; failures are logged and warned, never fatal.

phase.description: Non-null exactly while state is running.

reason.description: A failed run: one of the failure reasons; escalated: needs_input or blocked; otherwise null.

exit_code.description: The exit code the run ended with; null while running.

head_sha.description: The head from the resolve step, set at creation (the anchor head can differ).

escalated_at.description: Set exactly while the state is escalated.

finished_at.description: Set exactly for done and failed.

teardown.description: null when no agent was ever launched.

run.description: The run object: printed by run, resume, wait and show (--json) and listed by list. Text inside the stored artifact is untrusted; the marked fields are the ones in this object.

message.description: Closed codes, ids and counts only; never untrusted text.

reason.description: Required with code refused (a refusal reason). Also the no-run failures (code failed: tool_missing, tool_too_old, no_tmux, wait_timeout, schema_newer, state_unsafe) and the usage reasons (code usage: previous_mismatch, previous_not_done, skill_not_found, label_reserved, pr_too_long).

details.description: Closed codes, ids and counts only (for example the tool name and its install command, the matching run ids of an ambiguous prefix).

lower_code.description: A sibling tool's closed error code; never its message.

hook.description: The hook that vetoed or escalated (code vetoed or escalated); null otherwise.

decision_ids.description: Decision ids a pre-run hook printed; present with hook.
